claims.text: The model architecture consists of an ensemble of decision tree classifiers and a deep learning architecture that combines visual and textual features.
The visual features are derived from the VGG16 CNN, and the textual features are encoded using a 1024-dimensional LSTM model.
The final layer of the architecture is a softmax layer that outputs probabilities for agreement and disagreement labels.
